The ASV recasts הָיְתָה ... לְכָלֵב ... לְנַחֲלָה as *became the inheritance of Caleb*: the first לְ takes the written *of* (rules 11, 19), the resultative לְ is `unrepresented` because the written הָיָה carries the frame (rule 21), and נַחֲלָה takes the supplied *the* (rule 15). Rule 49's fused genitive does not reach the first לְ, since an English preposition is written for its relation.
עַל־כֵּן → *Therefore* fuses as a pair of function morphemes headed on the governing first one (rules 23, 30).
מִלֵּא אַחֲרֵי is divided as in vv. 8 and 9 — *wholly* to the verb, *followed* to the preposition — each morpheme holding a word of its own.
